versions.changelog:
Initial release of Azure语音转写专业版 providing advanced, enterprise-grade speech transcription features.

- Supports real-time streaming transcription with speaker diarization and multi-language handling.
- Offers batch transcription queue management for large-scale audio processing.
- Integrates custom speech models to improve recognition in specialized domains.
- Includes API usage examples and scenarios for meetings, customer service, and multi-language subtitling.
- Provides export of transcription results in SRT, VTT, and JSON formats.
